decisions: The codex/pilot-safety checkout is an exploratory remediation branch. Historical main/PR milestones are retained as history; current execution requires its own exact manifest approval and host-wide accounting reconciliation. No paid execution is authorized.

The non-frozen 13_PHASE3_INTEGRATED_RECOMMENDATION_2026-08-10.md is an opinionated proposal for Connor's separate-model review, not a human decision or call authorization; its companion prompt requires a claim-by-claim external verdict.
The non-frozen 12_PHASE3_CONNOR_DECISION_WORKSHEET_2026-08-10.md records Connor's current positions and all alternatives; open questions remain and it authorizes no call.

Connor supports a planned shared 30-of-33 HMMT-2026 subset, separate arm sampling, standard 32K GPT-OSS-120B, Terra in principle, and descriptive/bootstrap-first analysis; standard Inkling's scientific direction is accepted while its scope/allocation and the broader Tinker model portfolio are reopened.
A future Tinker reliability smoke is proposed under a $2 hard ceiling only after scientific freeze and a reviewed one-submission runner; no smoke is currently authorized.
The reviewed D01-D15 recommendations are advisory, remain human-pending, and authorize no calls; smoke may only activate an unchanged frozen panel or omit it.
PR #3 was human-merged at 7c83085 before Phase 3 began; Codex did not merge it.
PRs #4, #1, #2, and #5 were human-merged before Phase 2 integration; Codex did not merge them.
Tinker 0.25.0 live probes are blocked because the pinned SDK resubmits internally.
DeepSeek V4 Flash is proposed through a direct Fireworks ZDR development-only lane but remains disabled until its route configuration and hard dollar ceiling are approved and committed.

The implementation exposes item-level sufficient statistics and expected independent-draw transition mass; supervisor freeze of final analysis choices, calibration metric, cap grid, and ceilings remains pending.
